name: Free body
description: A point with full 6-DOF pose (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw) and linear velocity (vx, vy, vz), with the self-referencing source terms that integrate velocity into position on each axis. Orientation states are present but undriven here -- nothing in the rod/crank templates constrains rotation, only distance. The same node plays three roles purely by which edges you attach: a fixed pivot (nothing connected), a kinematically-driven point (Crank drive), or a body that responds to constraints (Rod X/Y).
